scenario: AITA for playing videogames at 2AM on a Friday night. | Tldr: roommate calls me out for play video games at this time if the day. I was playing online to today with a couple of friends online. I am usually not very loud, but not very quiet either. Just like an average person having an average phone call. Is it moral to continue playing late but try to keep it quiet?

message.reasoning: Okay, so I'm trying to figure out whether it's right or wrong for me to continue playing video games late at night, even though my roommate is upset about it. Let me break this down step by step. First, I live with four roommates, each in their own room. Most of them are pretty loud when they're home. I usually play online video games when I'm free, especially these days. I was playing online today with a couple of friends online. I'm not very loud, but I'm not super quiet either. It's like having an average phone call. Around 2 AM, my roommate knocked on my door and told me he was trying to sleep. He seemed very angry. I know it's fair that I shouldn't be playing, but my friends always play very late and not early. Is it moral to continue playing late but try to keep it quiet? Hmm, so the main issue here is balancing my own activities with the needs of my roommate. On one hand, I enjoy playing video games, and it's a way for me to relax and socialize with friends. On the other hand, my roommate is trying to sleep and is getting disturbed by the noise. I wonder if there's a middle ground here. Maybe I can play at times when my roommate is less likely to be sleeping. Or perhaps I can use headphones to minimize the noise. But I'm not sure if that's enough. My roommate seems really upset, so maybe I need to adjust my gaming schedule more. Also, I notice that my friends play very late, but I'm not sure if they're causing similar disturbances. Maybe I should talk to them about it too. It might be a common issue in our house. Another thing to consider is the fairness aspect. If I'm expecting my roommate to respect my need to play games, I should also respect his need to sleep. It's about mutual respect and finding a balance that works for both of us. I'm also thinking about the bigger picture. If I continue playing late without considering my roommate's feelings, it might lead to tension in our relationship. Good relationships require compromise and understanding. Maybe I can set some boundaries for myself. Like, I'll play games only until a certain time, say 1 AM, to give my roommate enough time to sleep. Or I can find other ways to unwind that don't involve making noise. I should also communicate openly with my roommate. Let him know that I understand his concern and that I'm willing to adjust my gaming schedule. Maybe we can come up with a solution together that works for both of us. In summary, while I enjoy playing video games late at night, it's important to consider the impact on my roommate. Finding a balance through communication and compromise seems like the right approach. It's about respecting each other's needs and maintaining a harmonious living environment.
